evals.name: triggers-on-mz-hit-spark
evals.prompt: a hit spark for RPG Maker MZ, five frames, bright then gone
evals.expected_output: Fires /pixel-art:vfx. Reads the img/animations row in engine-layouts.md, writes a short timing table, authors one draw(frame) that fades by palette steps, renders the sheet and GIF with render.py, and reviews motion from preview.png.
expectations: Invokes the vfx skill, not animate
Takes the animation cell grid from engine-layouts.md
Fades by palette steps rather than partial alpha
Reviews motion from preview.png because a GIF shows only its first frame

evals.name: declines-effekseer
evals.prompt: make an Effekseer explosion for MZ, an .efkefc file
evals.expected_output: Does not write an .efkefc file. Says MZ's native effect format is Effekseer and out of scope, and offers the MV-style pixel cell sheet instead.
expectations: Names Effekseer as out of scope

evals.name: near-miss-walk-cycle-routes-to-animate
evals.prompt: give my knight a 4-direction walk cycle
evals.expected_output: Does not fire /pixel-art:vfx. A character walk cycle is /pixel-art:animate.
expectations: Does not invoke the vfx skill for a walk cycle

evals.name: near-miss-still-sprite-routes-to-sprite
evals.prompt: draw a still 32x32 fireball icon, no animation
evals.expected_output: Does not fire /pixel-art:vfx. A single still image is /pixel-art:sprite.
expectations: Does not invoke the vfx skill for a still icon
